purpose: Current best-known continuation adapter for this ChatGPT reservation environment.

semantics.provisional_arm: Crash insurance only. Use the current adaptive default offset and do not treat it as the desired normal next turn.
semantics.final_rearm: After the last useful checkpoint, set DTSTART from observed close plus the current adaptive default final offset. The final successful scheduler write wins for that invocation.
semantics.jitter: Scheduled timestamps are aggressive wake targets. Early or late provider dispatch alone is not a reason to idle or abandon safe work.

replacement_rule: This adapter is a default, not a product objective. A better supported wake mechanism may replace it after evidence-backed evaluation and rollback preparation.
